title: Upper bound for the query budget
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and rational $0<\tau\le1$, let $C=\lceil4/\tau^2\rceil$, $\delta=1/[40(n+1)(C+1)]$, $b=\lceil\log_2\lceil2/\delta\rceil\rceil$, and $m=\lceil2b/(\tau^2/4)^2\rceil$. The Goldreich–Levin query budget $n\cdot 2C\cdot 2m$ is at most $2^{21}n(n+1)/\tau^8$.
